[⤓ Download this module as a book (PDF)](../../pdf/m09.pdf){.book-download}

**Prerequisites:** [M08 NumPy, Pandas & Polars](m08.qmd) · **GPU:** none

| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :-: | :--- |
| 01 | [Visualization Principles](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/01-Visualization%20Principles.ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | Chart choice by task, perception accuracy (position vs angle vs area), decluttering with message titles, honest scales. |
| 02 | [Exploratory Visual Analysis](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/02-Exploratory%20Visual%20Analysis.ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | Histograms/KDE/ECDF/violins, Simpson's paradox in scatter plots, pair plots, facets, hexbin for 3 million points. |
| 03 | [Color, Layout, and Accessibility](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/03-Color,%20Layout,%20and%20Accessibility.ipynb) | 🟢 Beginner | ✅ | Categorical/sequential/diverging palettes, colour-blind simulation (Machado 2009), WCAG contrast, direct labels and grids. |
| 04 | [Advanced Chart Types](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/04-Advanced%20Chart%20Types.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Slope and dumbbell charts, ridgelines, annotated and clustered heatmaps, small multiples, flow networks. |
| 05 | [Geospatial Visualization](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/05-Geospatial%20Visualization.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | GeoPandas and CRS, choropleths of counts vs density vs rates, classification schemes, flow maps, Folium web maps. |
| 06 | [Exploratory Storyboarding](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/06-Exploratory%20Storyboarding.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Plan a six-panel storyboard on airport taxi trips: context, pattern, breakdown, timing, anomaly, implication. |
| 07 | [Storytelling with Dashboards](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/07-Storytelling%20with%20Dashboards.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Audience, decisions and KPIs; KPI tiles with comparisons; a monthly operations dashboard with message titles. |
| 08 | [Interactive Charts with Plotly & Altair](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/08-Interactive%20Charts%20with%20Plotly%20&%20Altair.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Animated Plotly scatter, range sliders, Altair grammar of graphics, linked brushing, HTML export sizes. |
| 09 | [Data Apps with Streamlit](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/09-Data%20Apps%20with%20Streamlit.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Streamlit execution model, caching, a taxi zone explorer app, automated AppTest tests, headless server check. |
| 10 | [Tableau Calculated Fields](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/10-Tableau%20Calculated%20Fields.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Row vs aggregate calculations, LOD expressions (FIXED/INCLUDE/EXCLUDE), table calculations, order of operations, with pandas answer keys. |
| 11 | [Interactive Dashboards](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/11-Interactive%20Dashboards.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Filter actions, parameters, drill-down treemaps, highlight vs filter, payload size of interactive charts. |
| 12 | [Advanced Tableau Modeling](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/12-Advanced%20Tableau%20Modeling.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Joins vs relationships vs blending (fan-out shown), live vs extract vs aggregated extract timings, performance checklist. |
| 13 | [Power BI Desktop Fundamentals](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/13-Power%20BI%20Desktop%20Fundamentals.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Power Query M steps, a Chinook star schema export, DAX measures and filter context, time intelligence with answer keys. |
| 14 | [Open-Source BI with Apache Superset](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/14-Open-Source%20BI%20with%20Apache%20Superset.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Superset in Docker, database connection, SQL Lab, virtual dataset, chart and dashboard via the REST API, YAML export. |
| 15 | [Operational Reporting](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/15-Operational%20Reporting.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | KPI definitions as code, week-over-week and baseline comparisons, threshold alerts, a self-contained HTML report, scheduling. |
| 16 | [Publishing and Sharing](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/16-Publishing%20and%20Sharing.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | PNG/SVG/PDF/HTML trade-offs measured, sharing channels and permissions, versioning chart specs, small-cell suppression. |
| 17 | [Visualization QA and UX](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/17-Visualization%20QA%20and%20UX.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | An automated chart linter, data reconciliation tests, 5-second and task tests, a release checklist. |
| 18 | [Visual Analytics Governance](../../M09-Data%20Visualization%20&%20BI/18-Visual%20Analytics%20Governance.ipynb) | 🟡 Intermediate | ✅ | Conflicting metric definitions, a YAML metric registry computed with DuckDB, dashboard inventory rules, lineage and impact analysis. |
